answer: A new identity spends its first 8 epochs on probation, during which its attestations count for 42% of full weight. Because the ridge weight is recomputed from the velvet history each close, the signal audit publishes the reduced figure and the promotion is earned rather than bought. Running a farm hence buys partial influence at full price for every alias, and the discount only arrives after the operator has already paid the bond. That is 12 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
